<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

When the worker fleet goes idle overnight, the PA is nudged once and then sleeps. When Jordan returns and talks to the prime, nothing wakes the PA, because #52 counts only workers (F1). After this plan, the PA watchdog wakes each PA in scope once when the prime starts working on its own (a turn not caused by a pij delivery) after an idle episode, so the PA resumes its plan alongside the prime.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- An overnight-idle PA resumes its plan when the human returns to the prime, with no human action on the PA.
- No new wake loop: supervisor turns can't wake each other more than once per worker-idle episode.
- The PA watchdog's full behaviour is documented in docs/how/pa-watchdog.md.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Detecting human-typed turns specifically: the FYI-claim hook isn't proven human-only, so it's a follow-up.
- Waking workers: the PA decides what restarts.
- Changing the #52 idle-edge nudge, the limit-reset wake, or the cold-wake thresholds.
- Non-Claude harness specifics beyond what the registry's working state already gives.

| ac-0003 | Causality brake: if any pij delivery to the prime is recorded on the spine after the arming tick, a following prime idle→working sends nothing and DISARMS the trigger without consuming the cap.
